external_primary_history.evidence: Italian State agreed to recognise civil effects of canon-law sacramental marriage, with registration
Prior to 1929, canon-law marriage had no civil effects without separate civil marriage under the then operative Italian system

finding: The Q409–410 claims reflect the post-1929 concordat regime and cannot be treated as personally authored or approved wording by Pius X, who died in 1914. Exact later edition responsible not established. Q411 is held as collateral edition-sensitive wording.
scope: Edition-integrity defect demonstrated in marriage section; do not infer other 430 question texts are all incorrect, but do not claim any is exact 1912 facsimile-certified wording.
block_actions: Do not attribute Q409–411 Italian text directly to St Pius X or the original 1912 printing
Mark Italian digital text as a possibly modified later catechetical witness, not a print-original
Require actual pre-1914 print scan comparison before upgrading any family to authentic 1912 wording
Preserve existing source owner/index pending separate supervised reconciliation; do not silently rewrite original data
